text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Nice Nature...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I just saw the new prizes in that claw
machine over
there.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nice Nature points toward a claw
machine filled
with Umamusume
plushies.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I saw the same one at a store in the
shopping
district the other day. I was
pretty impressed with
how popular they
are.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
It just caught my attention, is all. I'm not
the type
to like cutesy things, anyway.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You want one that badly? You have
interesting
taste.
choice_data_list_en: I want to be the one to get it.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Well, I'll be here watching. Good luck!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no way I can fail now!
